sections.heading: A Home for Our Community
sections.intro: Hindu Community Center of Greater Cincinnati (HCCGC) is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization registered in the State of Ohio as Hindu Community Center of Greater Cincinnati Corporation — celebrating Hindu culture, faith, and values and bringing together all generations through programs rooted in Samaj, Sahyog, Sanskruti, Shikshan, and Sewa. The website hccgc.org is the official website of the organization.

cards.title: Vision
cards.body: A vibrant space where Hindu Americans come together to celebrate, learn, and share their culture, faith, and values - while contributing to society at large rooted in inclusivity and the belief that divinity exists in everyone.

cards.title: Mission
cards.body: Offer programs and services that nurture the cultural, educational, social, and spiritual needs of the Hindu community and the wider society - fostering pluralism, unity, and a deep commitment to service.

cards.title: Core Values
cards.body: We are guided by Dharma, Sewa, Integrity, Service, Family Unity, Respect, Cultural Continuity, and Responsible Leadership.

sections.heading: Programs for Every Stage of Life
sections.intro: From fitness and music to games and wellness — our initiatives create spaces to connect, grow, and celebrate together.

cards.title: Sahyog Milan
cards.body: A joyful gathering for Hindu seniors — sharing meals, games, conversations, and culture while inspiring the next generation.

cards.title: Sangeet Sandhya
cards.body: A community evening celebrating the joy of music — performances, participation, and togetherness for all ages.

cards.title: Khel Sandhya
cards.body: A warm community evening of indoor games — table tennis, carrom, chess — friendly competition and meaningful connection.

cards.title: Yoga For All
cards.body: A 12-week holistic healing course — gentle movement, breathwork, and meditation designed for all fitness levels.

cards.title: Shakti Sadhana
cards.body: A 6-week functional fitness program — building strength, mobility, and stability using only bodyweight and household items. No gym needed.

cards.title: Dharma 101
cards.body: A 12-week introduction to Hindu Dharma — exploring scriptures, philosophy, yoga, ethics, and daily practice. Open to all seekers, beginners, and families.

banner.heading: Curious What's Happening Next?
banner.body: See our full calendar of upcoming events, programs, and gatherings at HCCGC.

sections.heading: Four Spaces for Every Occasion
sections.intro: From large cultural gatherings to intimate meetings, our four rooms are available for your community and organizational events. Weekday discounts and nonprofit rates available.

Hindu Community Center of Greater Cincinnati is more than just a building, it is a home for our community. A place where children learn their roots, families come together to celebrate, traditions are preserved, and future generations stay connected to their heritage. Your support helps bring this vision to life - one step at a time. Together, we can build and sustain a space that nurtures connection, preserves heritage, and inspires future generations. Your support is truly invaluable.

columns.body: Donations play a vital role in sustaining this center, supporting day-to-day operations, maintaining the facility, and enabling cultural, educational, and community programs. Your generosity also helps us expand our efforts and undertake new initiatives that strengthen and serve the Hindu community for years to come.

Contribute your time and skills to support events, programs, and the day-to-day needs of the center. From helping with setup and coordination to assisting during activities, your involvement plays an important role in keeping everything running smoothly.
